source: Written by the framework QA agent and reviewed by the developer on 2026-10-26; expected answers follow Armando's definitions but are not yet reviewed by him. A published label outside expect* and accept* counts as wrong; an expected label not published counts as missed.

items.text: Billionaires should pay an annual wealth tax
items.note: Clear positive (ECO-2L wealth tax; Tax fairness alias Pro-wealth tax). Socialist is wrong: a tax is not a legal cap on wealth. Liberal/Progressive only by association: count as extra until Armando rules.

items.text: Sanctuary city policies should be ended
items.note: Clear positive (NAT-2R). MAGA is wrong: no Trump, America First or MAGA.

items.text: Sanctuary policies make American cities more dangerous
items.note: E2 positive with the same shape as Armando's 'Trump's immigration crackdown makes the United States safer'. If Armando rejects E2, expect No label and [].

items.text: Mail-in ballots should be sent automatically to every registered voter
items.note: Clear positive (LAW-2L wider voting access; alias Pro-mail voting).

items.text: Abortion should not be legal
items.note: Negation test: Pro-choice or Left is a reversed label. Christian conservative/Conservative only by association (pending Armando).

items.text: Raising the minimum wage does not kill jobs
items.note: Negation of Armando's example. Pro-wage flexibility or Right is a reversed label. Pro-living wage/Left is defensible under E2 but the claim only rebuts: debatable, expect nothing.

items.text: Raising the minimum wage may cost some jobs
items.note: Hedged concession (H1). P2 blocks the leaning today, but I3 ignores hedging, so Pro-wage flexibility can still be published: it should not be.

items.text: Immigration reform should pair more border agents with legal status for long-term undocumented residents
items.note: NAT-0 compromise. Neither immigration side: the claim holds both.

items.text: Taxes on the wealthy should be raised and illegal immigrants should be deported
items.note: A1 mixed signals (ECO-2L + NAT-2R): never Center. Both issue sides are clear. Populist is wrong (no people-versus-elite framing).

items.text: Naturalized Muslims should be stripped of their citizenship
items.note: NAT-3R. Nationalist/Paleoconservative/Christian conservative are association guesses: not expected.

items.text: Should the Electoral College be abolished?
items.note: A question takes no position (G1).

items.text: Sure, cutting taxes for billionaires always trickles down to workers
items.note: Sarcasm. The literal reading (Pro-tax cuts, Right) is a reversed label; the intended reading (Tax fairness, Left) is debatable to infer. Expect nothing.

items.text: The Fort Hood shooter deserves the death penalty
items.note: One named case sits between LAW-1R (one specific violent crime) and LAW-2R: A5, no leaning. v3.3 published Right on Armando's similar Nidal Hasan claim, where he gave only Pro-death penalty.

items.text: Trump's tariffs are destroying American farmers
items.note: Mentions Trump while opposing his policy: MAGA or Protectionist is a reversed label. Pro-trade is defensible under E2 (mirror of Armando's Dayton free-trade claim) but debatable.

items.text: Undocumented immigrants who have lived here for a decade should be given legal status
items.note: Name collision: 'Pro-legalization' is both the Drugs side and a Pro-immigration alias; Pro-legalization is wrong. Leaning sits between NAT-1L (narrow group) and NAT-2L: A5.

items.text: States should require photo ID to vote, but accept many kinds of ID and provide them free to anyone who needs one
items.note: LAW-1R positive (explicit centrist limit). Right would be the wrong level.

items.text: Vaccines cause autism
items.note: Medical/scientific claim (G3). E2 must not turn it into Pro-vaccine choice, which is about mandates and choice.

items.text: Vaccine mandates violate bodily autonomy
items.note: Clear side. No criterion covers vaccine mandates, so no leaning. Libertarian/Libertarianism by association: extra.

items.text: Amtrak should require passengers to be vaccinated against highly contagious diseases
items.note: Real Geo claim 119164f3. Pro-regulation would be a general side stacked on a specific one (proposed I6).

items.text: Fluoridated drinking water lowers children's IQ
items.note: Scientific effect claim. Pro-vaccine choice via the 'MAHA' alias is a keyword error.

items.text: Social media use harms teenagers' mental health
items.note: Effect of a technology, not of a policy. Pro-online safety or Deaccelerationist would be E2 overreach.

items.text: Mental health screening in schools should require explicit parental consent
items.note: Real Geo claim 003f8d53. Right (SOC-2R parental rights) vs Center right is debatable (A5). Christian conservative/Conservative are wrong: no religious or traditional framing.

items.text: The FDA should approve psychedelics for therapeutic use
items.note: Real Geo claim 20b6fdb8. Pro-legalization (removing criminal penalties) is wrong: drug approval is not decriminalization.

items.text: Doctors must obtain informed consent before any treatment
items.note: Shared medical ethics (G3/G4). Pro-vaccine choice via the 'Pro-informed consent' alias is a keyword error.

items.text: Technology transfers for pandemic vaccines and treatments must remain strictly voluntary
items.note: Real (opinion-seed7). v3.3 published Libertarian + Libertarianism (both via I5) and Right passed P1-P5 with country 'Global'. Global IP policy: no US-scale leaning; traditions not characteristic.

items.text: Bitcoin is a hedge against inflation
items.note: Investment claim about an asset, not a policy: E2 must not make it Pro-crypto.

items.text: The SEC's crypto crackdown pushed innovation offshore
items.note: E2 on a policy (SEC enforcement), general effect. Pro-deregulation not expected (specific before general). Crypto is not in the criteria: no leaning.

items.text: Illinois should repeal its 0.2% digital asset tax
items.note: Real Geo claim 1a1bb98d. Pro-crypto acceptable. Leaning between ECO-1R (targeted relief) and ECO-2R: A5.

items.text: The US needs clear stablecoin rules so the crypto industry can grow
items.note: Crypto skeptic (alias 'Pro-crypto regulation') and Pro-regulation are wrong: the rules are wanted to help crypto grow.

items.text: The Federal Reserve should stay hawkish until inflation is back at 2%
items.note: Monetary policy is not a partisan-camp split (G4). Hawk (Use of force) is a keyword error.

items.text: The US government should regulate artificial intelligence to slow its development
items.note: Real Geo claim 1019d26f; both sides match their descriptions. X-TECH: no leaning.

items.text: AI companies that build superintelligence should face the corporate death penalty
items.note: Real Geo claim 0904efac. Keyword trap: Pro-death penalty is wrong. Deaccelerationist acceptable.

items.text: Frontier AI models should undergo mandatory third-party safety evaluations before release
items.note: Real (opinion-seed7). v3.3 also published Pro-regulation, a general side stacked on the specific one; Armando's analogous example has Pro-AI regulation only.

items.text: Federal law should preempt state AI laws
items.note: Both via Armando's own names (Pro-AI preemption; Pro-federal preemption). Pro-states' rights is reversed.

items.text: AI will eliminate half of entry-level office jobs within five years
items.note: Prediction about a technology (G1). E2 must not apply.

items.text: Regulators should block major AI companies from acquiring hardware and media startups
items.note: Real Geo claim 085535d3. Antitrust: Deaccelerationist fits its aliases (Antitrust, Trustbuster) but not its description (slowing technology); card conflict, ask Armando. Expect nothing.

items.text: AI developers should deliberately pace the development of frontier models
items.note: Real (opinion-seed7); v3.3 correct. Pro-AI regulation is wrong: no government role (the verifier rejected it correctly).

items.text: The UK should bring its railways back into public ownership
items.note: C1: mainstream UK Labour policy. Far left via ECO-3L ('nationalize major industries') and Socialist/Democratic socialist are wrong.

items.text: The NHS should remain free at the point of use
items.note: Consensus across UK parties (G4 under C1). Left + Pro-universal healthcare would apply a US lens.

items.text: Taiwan should formally declare independence from China
items.note: Clear side (Armando's spelling). X-FOR: no leaning.

items.text: The US should keep its policy of strategic ambiguity on defending Taiwan
items.note: Alias trap: 'Ambiguity advocate' and 'Pro-status quo' sit under Pro-Taiwan reunification, which this claim does not support.

items.text: The war in Ukraine should end through a negotiated settlement
items.note: Alias trap: 'Pro-negotiated settlement' and 'Pro-peace deal' sit under Pro-Russia ('Supports Russia's government, interests'). Pro-Russia is wrong.

items.text: The US should give Ukraine long-range missiles to strike military targets inside Russia
items.note: Clear side. Hawk debatable (Armando lists 'Ukraine hawk' under Pro-Ukraine; open question).

items.text: Israel and Hamas should agree to a permanent ceasefire
items.note: Alias trap: 'Pro-ceasefire' sits under Pro-Palestinian; ceasefire calls came from both camps. Debatable: expect nothing.

items.text: Israel should not exist as a Jewish state
items.note: Tests the 3-sided issue: Pro-Palestinian overlaps rather than opposes, and today its score above 0.1 blocks Anti-Zionist. Pro-Palestinian acceptable.

items.text: Kashmir is an integral part of India
items.note: A country's official position in a territorial dispute (G4). Nationalist is wrong (Nationalist card exclusion).

items.text: The UK should restore its foreign aid budget to 0.7% of national income
items.note: Pro-USAID is about US aid through USAID: wrong for the UK. No other card fits.

items.text: The United States should end its military conflict with Iran
items.note: Real Geo claim 000d7436. Paleoconservative/Isolationist are wrong (one intervention; the typical-leaning filter is skipped on cross-cutting claims). Pro-Iran diplomacy debatable.

items.text: Congress should block the U.S.-Saudi civil nuclear agreement
items.note: Real Geo claim 080f6a9b. Keyword trap: Anti-nuclear (nuclear power) is wrong; this is non-proliferation.

items.text: Washington elites have rigged the economy against working families
items.note: People-versus-elite framing, used by left and right: no leaning.

items.text: Government should help people when they need it, such as through education and basic necessities, without establishing a total command economy
items.note: Real Geo claim 283412fe. Between Center left and Left (A5). Social democrat defensible; Liberal/Progressive by association are extra.

items.text: The First Amendment protects freedom of speech, and media should be able to speak freely
items.note: Real Geo claim 1060f4c1. Free expression in general (G4). Classical liberal/Pro-internet freedom are wrong.

items.text: Joe Rogan argued that the Federal Reserve should be abolished
items.note: Attributed (G2).

items.text: Why should taxpayers fund foreign wars while veterans sleep on the streets?
items.note: Rhetorical question. Isolationist/Populist/Pro-foreign aid reform are debatable readings: expect nothing.

items.text: Voter turnout in Georgia rose after its 2021 election law took effect
items.note: Statistic/history (G1). On the real version of this claim (fresh-seed3) the v3.3 scorer applied E2 and matched LAW-2R + Pro-election integrity.

items.text: Private ownership of factories and farmland should be abolished and handed to workers' councils
items.note: ECO-3L positive. Communist defensible; Liberal/Progressive/Social democrat are wrong.

items.text: Same-sex couples should have the same adoption rights as opposite-sex couples
items.note: Clear positive in this space (SOC-2L).

items.text: No-fault divorce should be abolished
items.note: SOC-2R bold plan. Christian conservative/Traditionalist/Conservative acceptable only by association (pending Armando).

items.text: In a serious relationship intended for marriage, the man should lead and pay for as much as he can
items.note: Real Geo claim 2b535a65. Personal relationship advice (G3). Traditionalist/Social conservative are wrong.

items.text: Polyamory should be society's default
items.note: Real Geo claim 03a30bf0. Not a policy; Far left via SOC-3L (abolish marriage) is wrong. Debatable: expect nothing.
